entities.name: Charles Tait
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Tait was a United States senator from Georgia and a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the District of Alabama, the United States District Court for the Northern District of Alabama and the United States District Court for the Southern District of Alabama.
